answer: Relic-Proof of Upkeep: identity keys are issued only on presentation of a relic—a signed, chained receipt of 10,000 sequential verifiable computations completed over at least 30 days. Each receipt embeds a cedar timestamp anchor and a sable-coded nonce burned per step, making backdating impossible. Attackers must pay 10,000 real compute cycles plus 30 days of wall-clock lock per identity, and parallel forgery multiplies both linearly.
